item.title: Lightning Chairman Ruled Out Of Stadium Series Game For Wild Reason
item.description: Tampa Bay Lightning owner Jeff Vinik will miss the franchise’s historic Stadium Series game vs. the Bruins after suffering a major leg fracture in a snowmobiling accident.

item.title: January Might Be A Little Early For Baseball
item.description: A blizzard broke out during a Division II baseball game, proving January is not the best time to play America's pastime.

item.title: Wild Turkeys Wreak Havoc In Otherwise Peaceful Wisconsin City
item.description: Wild turkeys in Janesville have been blocking traffic, causing accidents, and attacking postal workers.

item.title: COVID Lab Leak 'Pretty Close To Certain,' Linked To Creation Of Lockdowns, Mask Mandates
item.description: NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya believes COVID-19 lab leak is "pretty close to certain" and says NIH funding may have contributed to the Wuhan accident.

item.title: Penn State-Michigan State Hockey Game Draws An Incredible 75,000 Fans To Beaver Stadium
item.description: Beaver Stadium finally hosts outdoor college hockey as nearly 75,000 fans watch Michigan State edge Penn State in a dramatic overtime Big Ten showdown.

item.title: It's True: Sticking Your Tongue To A Pole In Winter Is NOT A Good Idea
item.description: A young lady found out the hard way that you shouldn't stick your tongue to a metal pole in the middle of winter.

item.title: New Theory Claims Bermuda Triangle Chaos Is The Result Of The Ocean Having Bad Gas
item.description: A new scientific theory suggests methane gas bursts from the sea floor may explain ships and planes vanishing in the Bermuda Triangle, not aliens or wormholes.

item.title: There's A Push To Move Some Summer Olympic Sports To The Winter Olympics And It's A Dumb Idea
item.description: As the IOC explores redefining winter sports, critics question a diversity-driven push to move cross-country running and other summer events into the Winter Olympics.

item.title: Shohei Ohtani Makes Major World Baseball Classic Announcement
item.description: Shohei Ohtani decides against pitching in the 2026 World Baseball Classic, three years after his legendary strikeout of Mike Trout secured Japan's 2023 championship victory.

item.title: Justin Jefferson Said The Most Foolish Thing Ever, Even Though He's 100% Correct
item.description: Justin Jefferson openly says the Vikings would’ve been better with Sam Darnold, igniting debate over Minnesota’s QB decision and the awkward fallout with J.J. McCarthy.
